title: Receipt
description: Verdict receipt (03 §11.2): an in-toto Statement v1 whose subject is verdict.json and whose predicate carries the run manifest, verdict_hash, card_hash and the agent-trace head, so `veyltrace replay` can re-check the verdict. Written by Causivra at step 10b as canonical JSON; it keeps the in-toto shape, so it has no schema_version and predicateType carries the version.

subject.description: Exactly one subject: verdict.json with the SHA-256 of its file bytes (not verdict_hash, which hashes the canonical verdict JSON without verdict_hash and run_id; replay checks both).

items.title: ReceiptSubject
items.description: The verdict file this receipt attests.

name.description: Run-dir path of the subject file.

digest.description: Digest set of the subject file.

predicateType.description: Veyltrace RCA-verdict predicate type; its version is the receipt's contract version.

predicate.title: ReceiptPredicate
predicate.description: What replay re-checks: the embedded run manifest and the three result hashes.

run_manifest.description: The run_manifest.json object, embedded verbatim (replay requires canonical-byte equality with the file on disk).

verdict_hash.description: verdict.verdict_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical verdict JSON without verdict_hash and run_id.

card_hash.description: card.card_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical card JSON without card_hash.

agent_trace_head.description: line_hash of the last agent_trace.jsonl line after the chain is verified; null when the run has no agent_trace (e.g. AI off).

ReceiptDigest.title: ReceiptDigest
ReceiptDigest.description: Digest set of the subject file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verdict.json file bytes.
